name: cli-tools
description: A collection of lightweight, dependency-free CLI tools built with pure Node.js

scripts.install:csv: cd csv-tools && for dir in */; do cd "$dir" && npm link && cd ..; done
scripts.install:json: cd json-tools && for dir in */; do cd "$dir" && npm link && cd ..; done
scripts.install:encoding: cd encoding-tools && for dir in */; do cd "$dir" && npm link && cd ..; done
scripts.install:system: cd system-tools && for dir in */; do cd "$dir" && npm link && cd ..; done
